Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Abhishek Kumar, Advocate  For the State : Mr. Arun Kumar Singh, APP  For the O.P. No.2 : Mr. S. Khalid Shah, Advocate  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE JUSTICE SMT. SONI SHRIVASTAVA  ORAL ORDER 4 30-01-2026 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 and learned APP for the State.
2.

The present case relates to an offence under Section 498A of the I.P.C. and upon hearing the parties, this Court is of the view that an amicable settlement between the parties can still be explored, in such view of the matter, let the matter be referred to the Mediation and Conciliation Centre of the Patna High Court.
3. Both the parties agree to appear either physically or through online mode before the Mediation Centre on 16.02.2026 Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.56020 of 2021(4) dt.30-01-2026 along with this order and other relevant documents.
Thereafter, Mediation Centre will fix further date.

4. List this case on 16.03.2026.
(Soni Shrivastava, J) anand/-
